title: DetectorDemandReported
description: A loop or radar detector reported demand on an approach over a sampling window. Measured, not inferred: the detector reports occupancy directly.

detector_id.description: Detector identifier, unique within the controller.

approach.description: Cardinal approach to the intersection. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

occupancy_pct.description: Fraction of the window the detector was occupied, percent.

volume_vph.description: Flow across the detector, vehicles per hour, extrapolated from the window.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
